div.p:
CONVERTS THE INTERFACE OF A CLASS INTO ANOTHER INTERFACE CLIENTS
EXPECT, LETTING OTHERWISE-INCOMPATIBLE THINGS WORK TOGETHER. USED
HERE TO DESCRIBE A COMPONENT THAT NORMALIZES MESSAGES BETWEEN
MULTIPLE CLIENT CHANNELS AND A SINGLE BACKEND REQUEST SHAPE.

APPLIES TO: PRESSW/PANTRYPAL_PLAN.D2 —
CHANNEL_ADAPTER NORMALIZES CHAT_UI/VOICE_UI MESSAGES INTO THE
SHAPE API_CHAT EXPECTS, SO A NEW CHANNEL CAN PLUG IN WITHOUT THE
BACKEND ROUTE CHANGING.

CLIPBOARD.D2 — WL-COPY/XCLIP, DRIVEN BY A
TEXTYANKPOST AUTOCMD, ADAPT VIM'S REGISTER INTERFACE TO THE OS
CLIPBOARD'S.
